theme_cn: 高频词汇 + 完形填空 + 键盘拼写

vocab.example_en: The payment went through in a second.
vocab.hint_cn: 买东西把钱给出去这一步

vocab.example_en: He took a photo of his card and put it in his wallet.
vocab.example_cn: 他给卡拍了照，然后放进钱包。

vocab.example_en: Please scan this code before you pay.
vocab.example_cn: 付款前请扫一下这个码。

vocab.example_en: Most students now read digital books on a tablet.
vocab.example_cn: 现在大多数学生在平板上读电子书。

vocab.example_en: Paying by phone is convenient for busy people.
vocab.example_cn: 用手机付款对忙碌的人来说很方便。

cloze.passage: Last Saturday I went to the community library as a 1___. The librarian, Ms Chen, showed me around and gave me a simple job. My work was to put the returned books back in the right 2___, and at first I made a few mistakes, but she told me to read the 3___ on each cover carefully. By noon I had finished two shelves. A little girl asked me for a story about 4___, so I found one with lovely pictures of pandas. In the afternoon we read aloud to 5___ children who came with their parents. When I left, Ms Chen smiled and said I had done a good 6___.
sentences_cn: 上周六我去社区图书馆当志愿者。
图书管理员陈老师带我参观了一圈，还给我派了一件简单的活儿。
我的工作是把还回来的书按正确顺序放回去；一开始我出了几个错，但她让我仔细看书上的标签。
到中午我已经整理完两个书架。
一个小女孩向我要一本关于动物的故事书，我给她找了一本有可爱熊猫图片的。
下午我们给跟着爸爸妈妈来的更小的孩子朗读。
我离开时，陈老师笑着说，我干得很棒。

questions.explanation_cn: 去社区图书馆帮忙做事的人是志愿者 volunteer。visitor 只表示参观者。
put the books back in the right order 按正确顺序放回书，与后文看标签对应。
封面上贴的标签 label 写着编号，用来判断该放哪。
下文说 pictures of pandas（熊猫图片），所以是动物的故事。
跟父母一起来的、需要别人读故事的孩子，是更小的孩子 younger children。
do a good job 干得好，是固定搭配。

spell.question: 付款：p______ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: pay + ment 变名词，payment 读 /ˈpeɪmənt/。

spell.question: 钱包：w_____ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: wallet 读 /ˈwɒlɪt/，注意两个 l 和一个 t。

spell.question: 扫描：s____ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: scan 是重读闭音节，双写 n 再加 ing：scanning。

spell.question: 方便的：c_________ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: convenient 读 /kənˈviːniənt/，中间是 ven，结尾是 ient。
